policy: These contracts may only be weakened or removed after explicit user approval for the corresponding behavior change.

contracts.description: The main tab bar keeps routing through the existing tab-change handler.
Short tap, long press, record decision, new temptation, new goal, and quick custom-spend submission remain wired.
The regular Feed add button stays rendered beside the scrollable category rail and outside the optional coach-mark condition.

The Home hierarchy redesign preserves Almi, level, streak, saving rating, Today tabs and swipe navigation, history, goal, daily reward, challenge, Budget, Subscriptions, category filters, and income-prompt actions.
The fullscreen Goal Jar keeps its coins visible and starts sensor-driven physics only after the modal is presented while the app is active.
Preset/custom goal selection, amount editing, custom-goal creation, and Continue remain available.
First-run analytics consent offers equally reachable accept and decline actions, persists either choice, and continues onboarding.
Profile edit/save/cancel and Settings navigation remain wired.
Save, spend, pause, amount confirmation, edit tap, goal/budget links, and swipe actions remain reachable while the card is restyled.
A manual save or spend advances the active frequency window and restarts its countdown, while automatic confirmation preserves the already advanced schedule.
Auto-fit text keeps an absolute readable minimum under Fabric instead of falling through to the native 4-point fallback.
The Fabric auto-fit floor accounts for accessibility scaling, never shrinks readable text below 11 points, and converts Android points to native pixels.
The React Native text host accepts the absolute Fabric auto-fit floor and the postinstall step reapplies that fix after dependency installation.
The patched React Native text view config forwards absolute minimum and maximum font sizes to Fabric instead of silently dropping them.

Feed cards keep all existing actions and native vertical scrolling while long-press drag reordering uses stable keys, persists the user order, honors reduced motion, and excludes the level gate and archive from every drop target.
The temptation editor keeps every editable field, schedule control, save, cancel, delete, and goal-selection action wired through the existing handlers.
The temptation creation modal keeps title, amount, emoji, category, frequency, schedule, add, and cancel behavior wired while its layout and keyboard handling are redesigned.
Coin entry keeps dismiss, save, spend, manual amount, and slider behavior wired.
Repeated Fabric prop commits do not recreate an unchanged Android native modal dialog.
Daily reward collection closes and settles its calendar modal before starting the shared chest overlay, while complex Android modal cards avoid whole-tree alpha flicker.
The Tamagotchi redesign preserves every care, reward, customization, navigation, gesture, and celebration action.
The redesigned Tamagotchi menu keeps native control semantics, selected and disabled states, and an accessible alternative to the clean swipe gesture.
The Tamagotchi redesign keeps one canonical open event plus the established care, reward, party, customization, and skin-download analytics events.
Plan selection, purchase, restore, manage subscription, terms, privacy, and close remain connected end to end.
Android purchases explicitly route the trial toggle to either the free-trial offer or the paid base plan.
The paywall still invokes purchase, selection, restore, manage, and legal callbacks.
The abandoned-offer wheel is deterministic, lands on the real offer slot beside the free near-miss, honors reduced motion, and restores claim and decline paths after the result.

The active yearly trial keeps its exact duration on the yearly plan card, uses generic trial copy on the toggle and CTA, and preserves post-trial price, renewal, cancellation, and charge-avoidance terms next to the purchase action.
The post-purchase Premium overview stays dismissible from the final action, close control, and the native system-back path.
Premium Stories preserve close and completion while adding reachable previous, next, tap, swipe, reduced-motion, and screen-reader behavior.
Budget premium access, transfer persistence, debt-plan persistence, proof picking, and analytics remain wired end to end.
Savings/debt switching, transfer proof, setup/edit debt plan, submit, cancel, backdrop, and hardware-back actions remain reachable.
Available-balance, debt-overpay, proof, OCR mismatch, APR, and persistence validation may not be weakened by visual work.
Progress destinations, internal Rewards navigation, system Back, actionable challenge/reward badge derivation, and the combined bottom-tab badge remain wired.
Challenge start, claim, cancel, confirmation, premium limits, reminders, persistence, analytics, and coin payout remain reachable after the Progress redesign.
Unlocked rewards remain claimable from the Rewards destination and continue updating claim state, coins, history, sound, haptics, and analytics.
Goal creation, editing, active-goal selection, long press, deletion, and repeat flow remain reachable when Goals moves behind the Overview destination.
Budget, subscription, income, weekly spend, free-day, rescue, and impulse-insight actions remain reachable when Insights moves behind Overview.

The Monthly limits redesign preserves editor entry, month selection, category history, slider and accessibility adjustment, exact input, reset, remaining edit, income entry, save, cancel, backdrop, and hardware-back behavior.
The Balance and potential redesign preserves disclosure, balance and forecast trends, category history, analytics, modal dismissal, and accessibility semantics.
The weekly savings and spending breakdown redesign preserves dismissal, range switching, period navigation, mode switching, and horizontally scrollable long ranges.
The Impulse Map redesign preserves the Premium lock entry and the existing expand/collapse path while adding calendar drill-down interactions.
The Subscription Watch redesign keeps home and Insights entry points, automatic discovery, manual creation, modal dismissal, import confirmation, and open analytics wired to the existing behavior.
The Progress bottom-tab badge remains the sum of actionable, unlocked challenge and reward notifications in native and fallback tab bars.
Challenge and reward claims remain idempotent and persist challenge state, earned badges, claimed rewards, claim totals, and health coin balance.
The prominent Overview Insights entry always remains visible and opens the full Insights destination, where the existing premium gates remain wired.
The Fridge redesign preserves open and close, edit, timer extension, spend, decline, overdue extension, swipe delete, Premium shelves, intro dismissal, and extension-modal actions.
Canceling a Fridge spend keeps the item, confirmed spend removes it only after the transaction commits, the editor uses temptation copy, and the summary preserves the exact amount.
The Fridge item modal keeps dismiss, name, amount, emoji, freeze-duration, create, and edit-mode behavior wired to the existing callbacks.

Every App.js text surface uses the shared Text wrapper, which removes custom font families on Android so device and theme typefaces remain native while scaling, localization, auto-fit, and RTL direction are preserved.

Every editable surface uses the shared TextInput wrapper, which removes custom font families from Android EditText while preserving controlled values, handlers, scaling, localization, and RTL direction.
The standalone premium story screen keeps bundled Inter off Android while preserving every intended weight on the native device typeface.

The localized, app-owned rating prompt is queued after the second successful save/spend across app sessions, waits until blocking UI has finished, keeps Later reachable, routes four or five stars to the store without a native review sheet, and routes one to three stars to a five-character feedback form addressed to support.
The rating trigger remains the second successful save or spend decision across sessions, with four stars as the store threshold and five visible characters as the feedback minimum.
The iOS home widget redesign keeps all three WidgetKit families, the home destination, quick save and spend deep links, and the daily-summary action.
The Android home widget redesign keeps small, medium, and large providers plus the existing home, quick-save, and quick-spend destinations.
The app-scoped install identity is set before the React root and AppsFlyer starts immediately without waiting for ATT.
AppsFlyer attribution and partner postbacks stay always on while ATT exclusively controls advertising ID access.
RevenueCat always clears legacy AppsFlyer sharing blocks and synchronizes the subscriber attribute so approved financial lifecycle postbacks can reach configured partners.

RevenueCat attribution preserves immutable identifiers for existing customers, writes final identifiers once for new customers, and serializes concurrent sync requests without blocking AppsFlyer partner postbacks.
Optional product analytics consent is persisted separately, ATT only updates IDFA access, and neither choice disables install or purchase attribution.
QA accessibility and layout remediation preserves onboarding continuation and terms access, Quick Entry submission and cancellation, save-overlay progression, and profile-photo selection.
Profile keeps support contact, every theme selection, and the underlying theme-change callback reachable while accessibility labels remain distinct.
Custom-category creation keeps its name and emoji inputs, validation, save, cancel, backdrop dismissal, and return to the category manager wired.

The first save still records the transaction, presents one save recap, grants its earned reward exactly once, and keeps later monetization eligibility without stacking a reward modal in the tutorial flow.
requiredFragments: first-save/onboarding reinforcement stays inside one blocker.

contracts.description: Scrollable screens continue behind the floating bottom navigation, reserve its measured height in transparent scroll tails, keep the status safe area opaque, and leave compact paywall disclosures in scroll flow.
Fallback and native iOS tab labels shrink within their item instead of collapsing to an ellipsis, while the full localized label remains exposed to accessibility.
The iOS 26 bar passes localized items, selection, theme colors and taps directly to one interactive native UITabBar without a cross-platform overlay.
One equal-width UITabBar owns every iOS 26 material, icon, localized title and badge, and installs its public items only after the first nonzero native layout resolves their width.
The same native UITabBar items that render the menu own selection and route each localized tab exactly once back to React.
requiredFragments: func tabBar(_ tabBar: UITabBar, didSelect item: UITabBarItem)

contracts.description: The compact paywall preserves the full hero artwork, keeps every secondary action in document flow, and overlays only the opaque purchase control above a measured transparent scroll tail.
The floating bottom navigation overlays a continuing screen layer while each scroll surface reserves the measured bar height plus a small end gap and an independent FAB-overlap allowance.
The compact Fridge owns only a small visual end gap, keeps an overflow affordance, and preserves edit, extend, resolve, delete, premium, and door-toggle actions.
Expanding the Saved hero reports its state to the app so the global FAB stays hidden until collapse without changing hero or FAB actions.
The collapsed Saved hero keeps its Details target outside the global FAB hit area while retaining the same expansion handler and minimum touch target.
The interactive iOS 26 UITabBar owns native tab hits directly while the legacy/Android fallback retains its accessible React Native Pressables.
The floating navigation host remains a concrete top-level native view above the active screen while preserving transparent pointer routing outside its children.
On short devices Profile places theme controls before the taller income block so Dynamic Type targets remain fully above the floating navigation without changing theme actions.
Legacy iOS fallback navigation keeps a minimum physical-bottom clearance while home-indicator safe area remains the larger single inset owner.
The category manager uses one visible vertical scroll owner while add, edit, delete, select, save, cancel, and done actions remain wired.
The fullscreen Save/Spend decision surface exposes scroll overflow and compact decoration while retaining close, amount, slider, goal, budget, timer, Save, and Spend actions.
Profile identity editing opens the visible Overview editor, focuses the first field, targets each field above the keyboard, and keeps save, cancel, and field updates wired.
The fallback tab badge is anchored to a fixed icon slot instead of the full button.
Every native tab item appearance applies the same public badge offset while native items retain their full accessibility labels.
R8 preserves the React Native bridgeless feature-flag method name that Expo resolves through reflection during release cold launch.
Every notification scheduling path is normalized through the typed Expo Notifications trigger API, including date, interval, recurring calendar, and Android channel-aware triggers.
Cold launch restores the animated Almost wordmark for both onboarding and returning users while storage hydration selects the correct destination behind it.
The iOS host owns a white scene-aware key window and yields long enough for its first Core Animation commit before React initialization blocks the Release main thread.
The locked Budget screen stacks title and Premium badge at accessibility font scales while preserving its preview, scroll path, and Premium CTA.
Almi Back, Skins, and Done stay individually exposed while the constrained skins sheet scrolls to every option without changing selection or close actions.
The temptation editor exposes both a native scroll indicator and a persistent pre-scroll continuation cue while retaining close, save, delete, and field callbacks.
The Feed widget rail keeps localized labels within two balanced lines at accessibility sizes while preserving each tab action.
The localized language rail measures and centers the selected card with stable LTR scroll coordinates while retaining every language action and selected state.
Closed previews and open Fridge items retain edit and decision actions while allowing pending titles to settle across two readable lines.
Almi sound interactions preserve sound playback while serializing native audio-mode initialization into one shared operation.
Closed and open Fridge summaries allow two-line auto-fit labels without changing the door, edit, extend, or decision actions.

The bug-report flow keeps open, cancel, validation, description/steps input, email submission, failure recovery, privacy-safe automatic diagnostics, and keyboard-accessible fields and actions wired on iOS and Android.
